notes.title: Massive Rival Megagun c1.1.1 patch!
notes.content:
The Rival Megagun c1.1.1 patch has just been pushed live for all users, and brings with it a whole host of changes and improvements, listed in great detail below.

Rival Megagun c1.1.1 patch notes

Gameplay:
- Extended chain duration in Easy and Normal modes
- Equipped gear icons now displayed in battle
- Reduced HP of large enemies
- Chain Item - When active, special attacks do not consume attack power
- Chain Item - When active, bullets cause splash damage to nearby enemies
- Chain Item - Effect duration increased

Online battles:
- You can now practice vs. CPU while waiting for a match
- You can now choose an avatar to display in online battles
- Unlock new avatars by playing online battles

Battle Settings:
- Reset attack power each round: Off/On
- Reset bomb count each round: Off/On
- Drone Fleet Size: Normal/Fewer Drones/More Drones/Too Many Drones
- Mega Gunship Mode: Pilot/Deploy (control the mega gunship directly or let the CPU control it while you keep playing)
- Mega Gunship Bonus: Off/Chain/Bomb/Repair (reward for destroying mega gunship)

Characters:
- Gen - Decreased damage output

- Buddy 2.0 - Increased damage output
- Buddy 2.0 - Reduced V-missile number of attacks
- Buddy 2.0 Mega - Reduced attack cooldowns

- Ruby Mega - Removed staggered bullets in basic shot
- Ruby Mega - Increased bullet amount for orb attack
- Ruby Mega - Decreased cooldown for lightning attack

- Smith - Fixed bug where Cluster Bomb would not fire
- Smith Mega - Increased number of bullets for ring shot
- Smith Mega - Reduced cooldown for basic shot

- Nano Mega - Increased control of ring shot

- Dr. Magic - Slight decrease in damage output
- Dr. Magic - Reduced range and pull strength of Vortex Bomb weapon
- Dr. Magic Mega  - Fixed bug where black hole attack could damage the player after mega gunship was destroyed

- Host - Increase damage output
- Host - Reduced speed and quantity of Swarm weapon
- Host - Squidlet no longer moves in a circle
- Host Mega - Decrease cooldown of attack C

Gear:
- Autobomb - No longer consumes bomb item
- Autobomb - Limited to once per round
- Exploding Shot - Damage is no longer affected by gear stats
- Exploding Shot - Fixed bug where shots appeared from off-screen
- Exploding Shot - Fixed bug where shots fired during bomb effect
- Magnet - Increased item pull strength
- Magnet - Items now stick to a small radius surrounding player ship
- Magnet - Effect is now only active while shooting
- Option - Increased number of bullets fired
- Compact Blasters - increase range
- Compact Blasters - Bullets now pierce through enemies
- Compact Blasters - Reduced damage bonus

notes.title: Rival Megagun c1.0.13 patch notes
notes.content:
Additions:
- Added playtime, match wins, and other data to Loadouts screen

Fixes:
- Fixed bug where initial bomb count was sometimes set incorrectly 

Adjustments: 
- (Mega Gunship, Ruby) Reduced bullet spread of Tempest Blade's basic shot with Mega Destabilizer equipped 
- (Mega Gunship, Buddy 2.0) Reduced spread of Buddy 2000's lasers with Mega Destabilizer equipped 
- (Mega Gunship, The Host) Decreased quantity of The Host (True Form)'s circular shot
- (Mega Gunship, The Host) Decreased inward curve speed of The Host (True Form)'s basic shot
- (Gear) Increased damage taken with Mega Destabilizer equipped 
- (Gear) Increased damage taken with Mega Deflector equipped 
- (Gear) Reduced size and speed of Mega Deflector bullets
- (Gear) Changed color of Mega Deflector bullets
- (Gear) Decreased damage caused by Exploding Shot
- (Weapon) Reduced Volatile Rocket quantity 
- (Weapon) Reduced Flame Slash speed and size
- (Weapon) Homing Rocket now fires more when charged over 100%
- (Drone) Reduced speed and quantity of Energy Ball Drone's shots
- (Drone) Monocle Drone no longer fires rockets from off-screen

notes.title: Rival Megagun c1.0.12 patch notes
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Fixed game freezing and other odd behaviour caused by Exploding Shot gear in network games
- Fixed bug that prevented some gears from unlocking for some players

notes.title: Rival Megagun c1.0.11 patch notes
notes.content:
Additions:
- Added option to dim gameplay background
- Added option to reduce intensity of enemy flashing

Fixes:
- Fixed no respawn after mega gunship is destroyed in network games
- Fixed missing player hit sound effects in network games
- Fixed P2's score displayed as "CPU" in network games
- Fixed score tally sound looping forever if player disconnects from network game
- Fixed bug where you can transform and take damage at the same time in network games
- Fixed desynchronized attacks in network games if both players have not unlocked an equipped weapon
- Fixed charge attack animation stuck after respawning from mega gunship in network games
- Fixed bug where you can repair and die at the same time
- Fixed Buddy 2.0's laser collision detection (Mega form)
- Fixed Ruby's instant lightning (Mega form)
- Fixed bug where drones could not be killed by bomb during time between chain expiring and spawn delay (commonly seen during mega gunship attack)
- Fixed display bug where HP bar appeared to be empty when Mega Gunship had a bit of HP left 

Adjustments:
- Increased Buddy 2.0's movement speed
- Increased Buddy 2.0's damage output
- Increased Gen's damage output
- (Mega form, Buddy 2.0) Increased bullet speed of Buddy 2000's basic shot
- (Mega form, Buddy 2.0) Reduced cooldown of Buddy 2000's spread shot
- (Mega form, Smith) Increased bullet speed of Giga Tank's basic shot
- (Mega form, Dr. Magic) Reduced range of Infinity Cannon's vacuum attack 
- (Mega form, Nano) Increased Buzzkill's seeking rocket speed and quantity 
- (Mega form, Nano) Increased Buzzkill's spread shot bullet quantity 
- (Mega form, Nano) Decreased Buzzkill's spread shot cooldown
- (Mega form, Gen) Decreased Phoenix Wing's spread shot cooldown
- (Gear) Reduced defense debuff for Mega Deflector and Mega Destabilizer 
- (Gear) Increased Compact Blasters damage bonus
- (Gear) Increased Exploding Shot shrapnel damage 
- (Gear) Reduced Option damage output
- (Weapon) Reduced range of Dr. Magic's Vortex Bomb 
- (Weapon) Increased pulling strength of Dr. Magic's Vortex Bomb 


Thank you for reporting bugs and helping improve Rival Megagun!
